items.title: Johnny St. Cyr Interview, 1958-08-27
items.q: Jimmy Brown was with the Golden Rule until then when they organized the Olympia band, he played with the band

ctx.x: Well they was, let's see, they was Mav Franks, he played the piccolo. Jimmy Brown played bass. Oh boy boy boy boy. Al C. Del C. Is he Mav's brother that played?
No, no, no. Al C. Frank.
